subject: Invoice origin & AP notification — who issues + delivery preference
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@aerowave.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@aerowave.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice origin & AP notification — who issues + delivery preference

Hi Diego,

Quick question from our AP team as we finalize onboarding: who will be the formal issuer of invoices for AeroWave — Redwood (bill from Redwood Inference) or will a local entity be issuing on your behalf? They need the issuer name for PO matching and also want to confirm delivery method: can invoices be pushed to ap@aerowave.com, or do you prefer we enroll in your billing portal and pull copies from there?

We also have to collect VAT proof for our records (EU customers). If you can send a sample invoice + VAT doc, that would help speed things up.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Lane
Finance Ops Manager, AeroWave

---
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@aerowave.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@aerowave.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin & AP notification — who issues + delivery preference

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note. Short answers up front:

- Issuer: Redwood Inference (Redwood Inc.) will be the invoice issuer for this account.
- Delivery: we support both automated portal enrollment and single-email delivery to AP. Both are OK; enrollments reduce ticketing overhead but AP emails are also supported.

I've attached a redacted sample invoice and our VAT certificate for your review. Two operational notes for PO matching:
1) Please match on "Bill To: Redwood Inference" and the invoice number (we include a 6-digit invoice id in the PDF).
2) If you need invoices to come from a specific sender email (for PO automation), tell us which address AP expects and we can configure the outbound-sender mapping.

Kimberly — can you confirm whether the portal invite flow will create copies in the AeroWave portal automatically (and if we should set the primary delivery to ap@aerowave.com while leaving portal copies on)?

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice_sample_202608.pdf, VAT_certificate_Redwood.pdf

---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@aerowave.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin & AP notification — who issues + delivery preference

Diego / Connor —

Confirming the portal behavior: if we send an invite for AeroWave it will do two things by default: 1) create a tenant view where invoices are retained for 12 months (we can extend retention with an add-on), and 2) send email copies to the primary billing contact (we set that to ap@aerowave.com during enrollment).

Operational recommendation for low-friction go-live: enroll AeroWave in the portal (creates the canonical archive) AND also enable primary email push to ap@aerowave.com for the first 2 billing cycles. That way AP can reconcile with their ERP while we confirm the portal export mapping. After that, we switch to portal-first with optional email copies.

Two small asks:
- Connor, can you add the AP sender mapping (outbound-from address) to the account config if AeroWave needs a specific from-address for match?
- Sophie, can you confirm whether AP requires invoice PDFs AND XML metadata (some ERPs need both)?

Thanks — K
Kimberly Park
Finance Integrations, Redwood Inference

---
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@aerowave.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@aerowave.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Redwood issuer + onboarding plan for invoice delivery

Hi Sophie / AeroWave AP —

Following up to lock this down. Final approach agreed internally:

1) Issuer: Redwood Inference will be the formal issuer on invoices (company name: Redwood Inference, EIN: 54-XXXXXXX).
2) Delivery plan (go-live):
   - Day 0: we will enroll AeroWave in the Redwood billing portal using ap@aerowave.com as the primary billing contact (portal copies retained).
   - In parallel: we will enable email push to ap@aerowave.com for the first two invoices to validate matching with your PO process.
   - After month 2: default to portal-first delivery; we can keep email copies on request.
3) VAT evidence: attached is our VAT certificate. If you need a specific statement on reverse-charge handling, let us know and legal can provide a one-line confirmation.
4) Outbound-from address: Connor will set the sender to invoices@redwood.ai unless you prefer a different address for automated ingestion. Please confirm.

Next steps for AP: reply with (a) confirmation that ap@aerowave.com is the correct primary email and (b) whether AeroWave needs XML metadata for ERP import. Once we have that, Connor will send the portal invite and we will push the first invoice copy.

Thanks — looking forward to the go-live.

Diego Fernandez
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice_sample_202608.pdf, VAT_certificate_Redwood.pdf
